email.subject1: a signal play for Higher Logic
email.body1:
Mark, saw Higher Logic just launched the Vanilla MCP server, opening community data to AI tools.

Shipping a new AI capability usually means more in-market accounts in play than reps can cover before they ramp, and that is where good deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Higher Logic off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mark, quick follow-up for Higher Logic.

With new AI features to sell into clients, the number tends to climb faster than headcount can, and most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit it. The gap surfaces late, when saving the quarter is already a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your client team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Mark, last bit of proof for Higher Logic.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Higher Logic's reply rate likely compares to other established community-software firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Mark, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters most right after a new launch, and I know running client sales is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a community-software motion? I will tailor it to Higher Logic either way.
